name: Ha Long seafood
summary: Hải sản at Bãi Cháy and along the Hạ Long shore is seafood cooked on the spot, often stir-fried, boiled, or steamed, and also dried.
origin: Bãi Cháy and the Hạ Long shore. Not a named shop.
howToEat: The winter line is xào, luộc, or hấp, and also dried.
On the Bãi Cháy evening streets. Grilled seafood runs along the shore road from phường Yết Kiêu to phường Hồng Hải.
where: Bãi Cháy and the Hạ Long shore, cooked on the spot. Phố đi bộ Bãi Cháy, chợ đêm Hạ Long, and Sun Carnival Plaza are the night cluster.
The shore road from phường Yết Kiêu to phường Hồng Hải, on the 6 May 2020 account.
seoTitle: Ha Long seafood — cooked on the spot at Bai Chay
seoDescription: Seafood at Bãi Cháy and along the Hạ Long shore is cooked on the spot: stir-fried, boiled, steamed, or dried.
